title: The UNTHINKABLE is About to Happen to Stocks (but most will invest wrong)
creator: Tom Nash
summary: Tom Nash argues an exceptional setup is coming — 'one of the greatest investing opportunities of our lifetime' — but that 90% of investors will waste it for lack of a decision system. The video is framework, not stock-picking: he contends more information without a system ('brain pasta') produces noise, emotional errors, selling winners early and missing drawdown buys. He lays out his system — pre-made trim rules (take 10% at +50% gains, 20% at +100% to fund DCA/cash flow), double-down DCA (buy double when an index is 10%+ off highs or a stock 20%+ off, back to normal at 9%/20% recovery, halve DCA pace if a stock runs 20% in 30 days), and a 125-point 'no-BS' quality filter scoring cash-vs-debt, revenue growth, margins, short interest, scalability, moat, CEO, recession-proofing and secular trends (100-125 = exceptional buy, 75-100 = watchlist). Mentions as illustrations only: Palantir (his 2020-era call, +2600% realized), Nvidia (+1500% since Oct 2020), Datadog (+120% since academy addition), Bloom Energy (+80% Feb), plus his 40% PLTR / 40% S&P 500 / 20% Tesla portfolio (+565% weighted since Sept 2023). No new explicit stock calls are made — PLTR, NVDA, DDOG, BE appear as past winners, not buy/sell recommendations. Closes promoting a free live masterclass Sat Oct 17 2pm ET revealing the full system plus two new stock picks. Caption note: auto-transcript mangles company names ('Palunteer'/'Palanteer' = Palantir, 'Bloom' references = Bloom Energy).
